summary: Sandbach United are just one week away from kicking off the 2026/27 season with an exciting new squad featuring brand new signings and welcome returnees. The Ramblers showed competitive form in their recent pre-season fixture against St Helens, though they fell short as their opponents made the most of their chances. With three new kits in place and player details being rolled out, the club is also looking for sponsorship partners ahead of what promises to be an ambitious campaign.
